map.Barrow Neurological Institute(BNI)疼痛分级，评: Barrow Neurological Institute (BNI) pain grading, assesses trigeminal neuralgia pain severity and medication control

map.三叉神经痛 BNI 分级 I 至 V：I 级无痛无需药物、II 级轻度药物可控、: Trigeminal neuralgia BNI grades I to V: I painless no meds, II mild medication-controlled, III moderate partially controlled, IV moderate medication-uncontrolled, V severe medication-ineffective; IV/V suggest microvascular decompression etc.
map.BNI II级 — 轻度疼痛，药物可控: BNI Grade II - Mild pain, medication-controlled
map.偶尔疼痛，药物完全控制: Occasional pain, fully controlled by medication
map.BNI III级 — 中度疼痛，药物部分可控: BNI Grade III - Moderate pain, partially controlled
map.疼痛仍存在但可忍受，药物部分缓解: Pain persists but tolerable, partially relieved by medication
map.BNI IV级 — 中度疼痛，药物不可控: BNI Grade IV - Moderate pain, medication-uncontrolled
map.BNI V级 — 重度疼痛，药物不可控: BNI Grade V - Severe pain, medication-uncontrolled
map.卡马西平：首选，起始100mg bid，逐渐加量至600-1200mg/d: Carbamazepine: first choice, start 100mg bid, titrate up to 600-1200mg/d
map.奥卡西平：起始150mg bid，可加量至1200-1800mg/d，副作用较卡: Oxcarbazepine: start 150mg bid, up to 1200-1800mg/d, fewer side effects than carbamazepine
map.微血管减压术(MVD)：根治性手术，适用于药物难治性TN，5年缓解率约70%: Microvascular decompression (MVD): curative surgery, for medication-refractory TN, ~70% 5-year remission
map.立体定向放射外科（伽马刀）：适用于不能耐受手术者: Stereotactic radiosurgery (Gamma Knife): for those intolerant to surgery
map.BNI分级是三叉神经痛疗效评估的标准工具，广泛用于术后效果评价。BNI I-II: BNI grading is the standard tool for trigeminal neuralgia outcome, widely used post-op. BNI I-II = satisfactory, III = partially effective, IV-V = treatment failure needing escalation. BNI can be reassessed to follow drug/surgery effects. Distinguish classic TN (vascular compression) from atypical TN (MS, tumor, etc.).
map.三叉神经痛疼痛缓解与药物依赖分级。: Trigeminal neuralgia pain relief and medication-dependence grading.
map.疼痛部分缓解、药物部分可控：BNI III 级（中度）。: Pain partially relieved, medication partially controlled: BNI Grade III (moderate).
map.完全无痛、停药：BNI I 级（无痛）。: Completely painless, off medication: BNI Grade I (painless).
map.I 无痛（停药）至 V 重度（药物无效）。: I painless (off meds) to V severe (medication ineffective).
map.疼痛强度与药物用量双重维度，术后常用。: Dual dimensions of pain intensity and medication dose, commonly used post-op.
